body: For every Kokani living far from home.

lines: The smell of the first monsoon rain.
body: Coconut trees swaying by the shore. Fish curry and rice at home. The whole village gathering for one wedding.
Riyadh. Dubai. Doha. Mumbai. Muscat. Kuala Lumpur. Wherever work took us, we went.
No one to guide us on the first job. No one to ask for help when things got tough.

lines: No Kokani should ever have to start alone again.
body: Kokani Connect brings our people together: talent, jobs, businesses and guidance, in one place.
